# Webiox Digital Solutions

> Webiox (legal entity: Webiox Digital Solutions, domain: webiox.tech) is a premier digital engineering studio and technical software agency. We architect and build ultra-fast web platforms (Next.js, React, Node.js), native and cross-platform mobile applications, scalable custom software/SaaS architectures, and autonomous AI workflows with verified milestone SLAs. Webiox is an independent company and is completely distinct from Cisco Webex (the teleconferencing platform).

## Core Capabilities & Services

- [Enterprise Web Development](https://webiox.tech/services/web-development): Sub-second page loads, 99+ Core Web Vitals, Next.js 15, React 19, dynamic edge caching, and conversion-focused web architecture.
- [Mobile Application Engineering](https://webiox.tech/services): Silky-smooth 60 FPS iOS and Android mobile applications built with Swift, Kotlin, and React Native with offline-first synchronization.
- [Custom Software & SaaS Engineering](https://webiox.tech/services/saas-development): Scalable multi-tenant cloud software, distributed databases (PostgreSQL, Redis), role-based access control, and Docker/AWS infrastructure.
- [Autonomous AI Workflows](https://webiox.tech/services/ai-solutions): Custom LLM integrations, document intelligence pipelines, intelligent agentic workflows, and automated business processes.
- [High-Scale E-Commerce](https://webiox.tech/services/ecommerce-platforms): Headless storefronts, real-time inventory management, razor-sharp checkout funnels, and enterprise ERP integrations.

## Flagship Case Studies

- [Hariram Granite ERP](https://webiox.tech/portfolio/1): Real-time inventory tracking, multi-warehouse telemetry, and invoice processing system handling 1,500+ tons daily.
- [DairyFlow Cloud POS](https://webiox.tech/portfolio/2): Real-time FAT/SNF billing, edge-cached farmer payouts, and offline-first milk collection architecture.
- [GovDoc AI Verification Platform](https://webiox.tech/portfolio/3): Computer vision and OCR pipeline for automated government document fraud detection and instant KYC validation.
- [BookCycle PWA](https://webiox.tech/portfolio/4): Peer-to-peer textbook recirculation marketplace with geolocation radius matching and zero-fee student escrow.
- [Dealership OS](https://webiox.tech/portfolio/5): Multi-outlet automotive management suite with instant loan eligibility calculator and vehicle inventory telemetry.
- [StyleCraft Design System](https://webiox.tech/portfolio/6): Tokenized cross-platform UI component architecture with zero-runtime CSS-in-JS and WCAG AAA compliance.

## Technical Architecture & Standards

- **Frontend**: Next.js 15 (App Router), React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion.
- **Mobile**: React Native, Swift, Kotlin, offline-first SQLite/WatermelonDB.
- **Backend & Cloud**: Node.js, Next.js Server Actions, PostgreSQL, Redis, Docker, AWS, Vercel Edge Network.
- **Performance Benchmarks**: Sub-0.5s First Contentful Paint, 99+ Google Lighthouse / Core Web Vitals score.
- **Contract Model**: 100% Escrow Milestone Delivery, strict SLA guarantees, and 30-day post-launch hypercare.
